versions.name: Camp Flying Eagle
versions.summary: A Southwest Florida Council Scout camp east of Bradenton in Manatee County, Florida, offering summer camp and year-round outdoor programs.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the community scout-camp-map project. The source mis-attributed it to Gulf Ridge Council; it is a Southwest Florida Council camp (Manatee County). Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate); elevation from the open-meteo DEM. Website, current program mix, and features NOT yet independently verified against the council site — flagged for a follow-up survey. July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add with corrected council (Southwest Florida, not Gulf Ridge). Existence confirmed; current operating status, website, and programs need verification against the Southwest Florida Council site; features unsurveyed.
